plotHookRolled: hook.festival_of_fools, hook.gods_fall, hook.environmental_gauntlet
plotHookTaken:  hook.environmental_gauntlet - the burning quarter is ground the master must hold and
then cut through, the fire itself the gauntlet. festival_of_fools and gods_fall set
aside: no feast and no fallen god in a tannery fire.
Rolled constraints (brief, binding): reach iron - steps iron 0.76 -> iron 0.82 - settings urban (rolled
arcane survives as the dyers' and tanners' vats, whose fumes take fire) - shape danger -> confrontation
-> aftermath (rolled personality fork, overridden by the brief) - consequence hand standing + place -
p3Shape mystery (read as: what the vats give off, carried into the failure reaction) - opposition
rival_agent (greed): the master tanner - disposition hostile - agentRole bystander_pulled_in (the watch
sends for the master) - scale region (read as the quarter and the street beyond it) - rarityTier 2 -
scale local - intrinsicTier shaping.
--- The narrator's 12 questions, answered ---
1 P1 arrival?      {actor} arrives in {location} as the fire bell rings over the tanners' quarter.
2 P2 events?       A dry wind spreads the fire; the vats' fumes burn too; three roofs are alight;
the watch has formed bucket lines from the river stair.
3 P3 one stake?    Danger: hold the lines, or the fire reaches the next street.
4 <=80 words?      77 (opening + step-0 spine).
5 Read aloud?      Every sentence is a report.
6 Stated?          The wind, the fumes, the breaking lines and the stake are stated, never encoded.
7 Every sentence works? Challenge, test or outcome.
8 Nothing unintroduced? The wind, the lines and the stair in the step-0 spine; the sheds, the hides
and the master tanner in step 1's, before any card acts on them.
9 One named person? Step 0 {cast:sergeant}; step 1 {cast:tanner}.
10 Stake in a sentence? Can the master hold the bucket lines and pull down the master tanner's sheds
before the fire takes the street beyond the quarter?
11 Cards verb+noun? Still The Wind, Steady The Line, Crack The Timbers, Show The Danger. No effect
line shares a word with its name; no digits.
12 Opening per class? urban, written.
--- Mechanical design block ---
Crux            Fire has taken the tanners' quarter, and the watch has sent for the agent to hold
the bucket lines and pull down the master tanner's sheds for a firebreak.
Shape           Danger - Confrontation - Aftermath. iron 0.76 (continue_weakened) -> iron 0.82
(fail_action). Linear, branch count 0. Mean 0.79. A step-0 critical_failure ends
the action.
Fight system    None. The master tanner and the journeymen are faced down, not fought; no fight,
confront, monster or rank gate.
Consequence hand (binding): standing + place, no swap.
standing      reputation_with $here +0.06 on step 1 success, -0.06 on step 1 failure, -0.02 on
step 0 failure (the master's name before the town).
place         apply_condition trait.condition.location.under_watch on $here on step 1 success
(the watch keeps men posted in the burnt quarter against looters);
apply_condition trait.condition.location.plague_scare on $here on step 1 failure
(the tanning pits burst into the river, and word of sickness keeps travellers out).
Extras          bond_change $cast:tanner -0.08 on step 1 success (the tanner's greed outlives the
fire: the master pulled down the sheds and the stock with them); bond_change
$cast:sergeant on both failure routes, so the critical_failure chips are backed on
both routes.
Cost channels   All specials essence-priced. No Heavy Hand, no rider, no grant.
Cool failure    The mortal is not hurt past a burn, jailed or branded. Two streets burn, the river
goes foul, and the master's name is spent before the town that sent for them.
Accepted limits The success_at_cost cost (two hook men hurt) is prose only. Plague Scare is chipped
on failure only, because critical_failure is shared with the step-0 route where it
never fires.
Systems quota   cast + reputation + conditions (place) - three, plus bonds.
--- Trait hooks ---
Gate? None. Variant? trait.personality.iron.virtue (Brave) +0.04, trait.reputation.iron.negative
(Brutal Thug) -0.04. Trait-only nudge? None. Trait fragment? None.

template.name: The Tannery Fire

openings.urban: {actor} arrives in {location} as the fire bell rings over the tanners' quarter.

steps.narrativeTemplate:
A dry wind is spreading the fire. The fumes from the dye vats burn as well, and three roofs are alight. {cast:sergeant} of the town watch has formed bucket lines from the river stair.

Each time a roof falls, men drop their buckets and run. {cast:sergeant} sends for {actor} to hold the lines. If the lines break, the fire will reach the next street.
steps.criticalSuccessAfterimage: The lines held through every falling roof, and the water reached the fire faster than it spread.
steps.successAfterimage: The lines held, and the fire stopped gaining on the street.
steps.nearMissAfterimage: The lines held, but a gap at the top of the stair let one more roof catch.
steps.successAtCostAfterimage: The lines held, but {actor} took a burn across the arm pulling a man from under a beam.
steps.failureAfterimage: The lines broke twice, and the fire took the drying yard along the river.
steps.criticalFailureAfterimage: The lines broke and did not form again, and the fire crossed into the next street.

nudges.name: Still The Wind
nudges.effectLine: Calm the moving air for a while, so nothing light is carried far.

bandProse.critical_success: The wind dropped as the lines formed, and the sparks fell back into the burning roofs.
bandProse.success: The wind slackened, and the sparks stopped carrying to the next row of roofs.
bandProse.near_miss: The wind slackened for a while, then gusted once and carried a spark over the stair.
bandProse.failure: The wind slackened, but the vats' fumes kept the fire going without it.

nudges.name: Steady The Line
nudges.effectLine: Settle the fear in a working crowd, so each person keeps their place when danger comes close.

bandProse.success: When the next roof fell, the men on the stair kept passing buckets.
bandProse.success_at_cost: The men held their places, and {actor} went in alone for the one who fell.
bandProse.failure: The men on the stair held, but the men at the river end ran.
bandProse.critical_failure: The men held their places a moment too long, and a falling wall broke the line in two.

steps.narrativeTemplate: The fire has reached the lane at the edge of the quarter. The drying sheds beside the lane belong to {cast:tanner}, the master tanner, and a season's hides hang in them. {cast:tanner} stands in the doorway with the journeymen and says no one touches the stock. The sheds must come down for a firebreak. Without one, the next street burns tonight, and the town will blame {actor}.
steps.criticalSuccessAfterimage: {cast:tanner} stood aside, and the journeymen helped the hook crews pull the sheds down.
steps.successAfterimage: {actor} got the hook crews past the journeymen, and the sheds came down across the lane.
steps.successAtCostAfterimage: The sheds came down, but the journeymen fought the hook crews first, and two men were hurt.
steps.failureAfterimage: {cast:tanner} held the doorway until the sheds caught, and the fire went over them into the next lane.
steps.criticalFailureAfterimage: The journeymen drove the hook crews off, and the fire took the street beyond the quarter.

critical_success.text: The bucket lines are holding the fire at the river stair.

success.text: The fire has stopped gaining on the street.

success_at_cost.text: They are working with a burned arm.

near_miss.text: One more roof caught at the top of the stair.

failure.text: The fire has taken the drying yard along the river.

nudges.name: Crack The Timbers
nudges.effectLine: Eat old beams hollow from inside, so a building comes down at the first pull.

bandProse.critical_success: The first shed folded at one pull of the hooks, and the next two went with it.
bandProse.success: The posts gave at the first pull, and the shed came down across the lane.
bandProse.near_miss: The posts gave, but the roof hung on its ridge beam and had to be pulled twice.
bandProse.failure: The posts gave, but the journeymen stood under the roof so no one would pull.

nudges.name: Show The Danger
nudges.effectLine: Make a coming harm plain to see, so a stubborn person cannot pretend it is far off.

bandProse.success: {cast:tanner} saw the sparks landing on the shed roof and stepped out of the doorway.
bandProse.success_at_cost: {cast:tanner} saw the sparks and gave way, but the journeymen did not.
bandProse.failure: {cast:tanner} saw the sparks, and sent the journeymen in to carry out the hides first.
bandProse.critical_failure: {cast:tanner} saw the sparks, and barred the shed door to save the stock inside.

traitVariants.factorLine: Being Brave, they stay on the stair while roofs fall.
Known as a Brutal Thug, they are not trusted to give orders to frightened men.

narrativeTemplates.initiation: Fire has taken the tanners' quarter, and the watch has sent for someone to stop it spreading.
narrativeTemplates.success: {actor} held the bucket lines and cut a firebreak, and the fire stopped at the edge of the quarter.
narrativeTemplates.failure: The fire spread out of the tanners' quarter, and {actor} could not stop it.

fallback.overview: The fire bell stops, and the watch walks the burnt quarter until dawn.

critical_success.overview: The fire went out at the gap where the sheds had stood. Not one house beyond the quarter burned, and no one was hurt at the sheds.
